summary: Augusta should not keep two current municipal rows. Augusta CCD is only a non-governmental Census county subdivision and is not a real annual local police control object. The correct primary municipal row is Augusta-Richmond County consolidated government (balance), which represents the consolidated Augusta government outside separate incorporated places. Production should drop the CCD row, reroute GA1210000 Augusta-Richmond County Sheriff's Office into the balance row as the active consolidated-primary reporting surface, collapse any legacy Augusta or Richmond County police aliases into that same row if they are kept at all, and stop treating GA1210700 Richmond County Marshal as an exclusive ordinary local-full driver because its official role is specialized civil, court, security, ordinance, and airport enforcement rather than general municipal policing.
